goal: Allow GUI frontends and multiprocess clients to initiate UTXO snapshot loading
Provide user progress feedback while snapshot coins are validated and populated
agreement: Strong support with no remaining objections after rebases and refactoring
Verified by testing mainnet snapshot loads with downstream GUI branches (pinheadmz, Sjors)
Resolved objection: passing file handles across IPC boundaries complicates separation (ryanofsky)
Resolved objection: signaling progress per coin would fire over 100 million times (pinheadmz)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it unblocks assumeutxo snapshot loading across process boundaries
Directly enables downstream GUI implementations to load snapshots with progress feedback

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because the RPC refactor primarily exists to provide test coverage for the new interface
Changes failure error codes to internal errors, which could affect external automation
